signatures.description: Build an R*-tree spatial index in JavaScript with STR (sort-tile-recursive) bulk loading and R*-tree node splitting driven by minimizing margin sum, then overlap enlargement, and forced reinsertion of 30 percent of the most distant entries instead of a split. Answer window and k-nearest queries with a correct branch-and-bound prune and expose per-level MBR area, overlap, and margin invariants plus a structural validator that detects entries stored under an MBR they do not intersect. Handle degenerate inputs: duplicate points, zero-area boxes, 10k rectangles near the same coordinate, and deletes that must collapse underfull nodes without breaking the level balance.
